scripts.build: echo 'No build step for infra; sst.config.ts is type-checked by type-check'
scripts.type-check: AWS_REGION=${AWS_REGION:-us-east-1} OWNER=${OWNER:-type-check} pnpm run install-sst && tsc --noEmit
scripts.diff: cd .. && sst diff --stage ${STAGE:?Set STAGE, e.g. STAGE=dev-yourname}
scripts.deploy: cd .. && sst deploy --stage ${STAGE:?Set STAGE, e.g. STAGE=dev-yourname}
scripts.remove: cd .. && sst remove --stage ${STAGE:?Set STAGE, e.g. STAGE=dev-yourname}

verifiedVersions.status: candidate - not yet verified in AWS; compatibility gate requires a real deploy of a disposable dev stage
